caption:
Three commands for good character, online and off

One short verse with three instructions for how we deal with people. Remember it the next time a conversation turns sour.

Surah Al-A'raaf 7:199

Which of the three is hardest for you right now?

#goodcharacter #akhlaq #onlinemanners #quranreels
